description: This file defines an interface (IAssertionUnit) for assertion units within the Thunder::Assertion namespace, including a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method for handling assertion events. It includes external dependencies on Module.h and Messaging.h.

classes.name: IAssertionUnit
classes.description: An interface for assertion units that can handle assertion events, with a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method.

methods.name: AssertionEvent
methods.description: Handles assertion events by processing metadata and message content.
